title: Soul Feast #35: Together Miniseries #5: The Journey Inside – Fear
excerpt: In this deeply illuminating Soul Feast, Gary continues the Together miniseries by guiding listeners inward – toward the uncharted territory of their own emotions.
bodyHtml:
In this deeply illuminating Soul Feast, Gary continues the Together miniseries by guiding listeners inward – toward the uncharted territory of their own emotions. While previous episodes contrasted external and authentic power through societal structures, this conversation brings that contrast home, into the interior landscape of the self. 

Gary invites us to look past the collapsing outer world and begin exploring the terrain of fear, pain, and emotional awareness that marks the beginning of true transformation.

As Gary explains, every personality has frightened parts – emotional energies rooted in powerlessness that often drive us to seek control, validation, and external success. These experiences aren’t flaws; they’re invitations. Gary illustrates how fear expresses itself through jealousy, anger, resentment, compulsions, and addictions. He shares how recognizing these emotional patterns isn’t weakness – it’s the first step in building authentic power. Beneath every compulsion, he says, lies the pain of powerlessness – and naming it allows us to begin healing it.

Spiritual growth, then, begins with fearless self-inquiry.

Gary encourages us to move inward with curiosity and compassion, acknowledging that fear is not negative – it’s human. And in doing so, we unlock the doorway to a new experience of love, reverence, and soul alignment.

Please do not take anything that Gary or Linda share as true just because they say it. If it resonates with you, experiment with it in your life. If it doesn’t, let it go.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

(01:15) – What looking inward really means—and why the old consciousness resists it

(05:50) – The difference between five-sensory and multisensory experiences of meaning

(09:10) – How fear hides behind addiction, compulsion, and obsession

(11:45) – The “fear basket”: what emotions reveal about the parts of ourselves that need healing

(15:00) – The pain of powerlessness: the emotional root of every frightened part of our personality

(18:30) – Why fear is not negative, but essential to the human experience—and how awareness transforms it

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:

This week, reflect on the emotional pain you’ve experienced in your life. Begin by writing down the moments that have hurt the most—loss, rejection, regret, or failure. Then, over the next few days, observe any new emotional discomfort that arises and jot it down. At the end of the week, return to what you’ve written and read it with compassion. These emotions are not weaknesses; they are the starting point of your journey toward authentic power.
